'''Sivoria''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].

==Description==
The [[Sivorian Sea]] was a vast ocean, famous for its deep, emerald-green waters.
